title.en: Sitrakal Oli (சிற்றகல் ஒளி) by Ma. Po. Sivagnanam

text.en: A small lamp can light up a great mind.

This lesson by Ma. Po. Sivagnanam says that everyone loves to listen to stories from childhood; reading stories is the next step, and it makes one a reader and a creator. It then presents a writer who makes himself known through his writing.
The lesson shows how reading and writing shape a person and how even a small light of learning can brighten a life.
Terms: சிற்றகல் (small lamp), ஒளி (light), படைப்பாளி (creator) and வாசிப்பு (reading).
